text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 6.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7.Resume Students who from Japan, Korea, Mongolia and Hungary don't need to provide. You can download a template or sample from here.
